sn4.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn4.7:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā bahud' eva rattiṃ ajjhokāse caṅkamitvā rattiyā paccusa-samayam pāde pakkhāletvā vihāram pavisitvā
sn4.7:1.3: dakkhiṇena passena sīha-seyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādam accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhāna-saññaṃ manasi karitvā || || 3.
sn4.7:1.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.7:2.1: Kiṃ soppasi kiṃ nu suppasi || kim idaṃ soppasi
